'''Nenmo's Curios''' was a business that was ran by the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] merchant, [[Nenmo]]. He had a shop on the [[Ithorian Herdship]] ''[[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|Bazaar]]'' and later ran a stall at the [[Cularin Trade Show]] aboard the ''[[TAV Prosperity]]'', which was held during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At the stall, he sold various rare but tacky items, including [[Celebrity Bobble Head]]s, various [[Datacard/Legends|datacards]], [[Bantha Smelling Salts]], a [[Dejarik/Legends|Dejarik]] board, and many other items.
